verdict.rationale: The OpenHands site describes an automation that detects failed workflows, inspects logs, identifies the likely cause, and opens a pull request with a proposed fix, which matches the story almost word for word. The GitHub README supports this with automations that integrate with GitHub and run on webhook events or schedules. Missing for 10: in-depth setup or configuration docs for the CI-failure automation (it is only a one-line marketing description), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works reliably.
